versions.changelog:
linkup-search v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Linkup Search skill.
- Provides step-by-step guidance on constructing effective web search and scraping queries using Linkup.
- Explains when to use standard vs. deep search depth, with pricing and capability details.
- Covers how to select appropriate output formats for different tasks (searchResults, sourcedAnswer, structured).
- Offers examples and best practices for parallel searches, sequential extractions, and crafting precise queries.
